results.title: Wall and floor ≥ 2.2 mm (1.5 m drop, SLA/PA12)
Gasket compression 20–30 % and groove fill ≤ 85 %
Screw spacing around the seal ≤ 60 mm
Gasket bend radius ≥ 3 × cord diameter
results.source: cord gaskets kink and leak at tight corners

results.title: Groove clear of screw bosses by ≥ 0.8 mm
results.source: thin wall between groove and boss cracks

results.title: Button ≥ 12 mm across (gloved finger)
Outer corner radius ≥ 3 mm
results.source: corners crack first in drop tests

results.title: Draft ≥ 1° on moulded parts
Screw engages insert ≥ 4 mm and does not bottom out
Button bead compression 15–30 %, plunger gap 0.2–0.5 mm
Ports sit on flat wall, clear of floor and lip
results.source: nut and O-ring need a flat face

results.title: Pigtail ≥ routed length u.FL → SMA + 20 mm service loop
results.source: no strain on the u.FL connector

results.title: Every penetration inside the seal line is sealed
results.detail: 6 screw holes inside the seal: O-ring under each head

results.title: Parts under the button collar respect the keep-out height
results.detail: room under collar 8.0 mm, keep-out 4.5 mm

results.title: Stack fits: battery, gap, PCB, components below the lid
Retainer ring press fit 0.05–0.20 mm on diameter
Every part is one valid closed solid
No interference between any two parts (assembled)
results.detail: no overlaps (gasket squeeze excluded by design)

results.title: Minimum clearances between neighbouring parts
results.detail: PCB to base walls/bosses 1.00, battery to PCB 3.60, module to lid 3.00, switch to plunger 0.30, SMA nut to battery 1.50, vent nut to battery 5.50, module to button retainer 5.01

results.title: PCB mounting holes on the board, hole edge ≥ 1.0 mm from board edge
results.source: IPC-2221 / PCB fab edge-clearance rules; drop-test board retention

results.title: Every wall port is an open through-hole that clears its bulkhead part
results.source: SMA 1/4-36 and M12×1.5 vent datasheets; IP67 bulkhead-seal practice
results.detail: SMA Ø5.2 bore 0.00 mm³ blocked, vent Ø10.0 bore 0.00 mm³ blocked

results.title: Every base boss has an open insert hole ≥ insert length + 0.5 mm deep
results.source: heat-set insert datasheets (M3 L5.7: hole Ø≈4.0, depth ≥ L + 0.5–1 mm); lid-clamp / IP67 practice

results.title: Heat-set insert pilot hole within datasheet window (M3 L5.7: Ø3.8–4.3 mm)
results.source: heat-set insert datasheets (M3 L5.7: hole Ø4.0, knurl OD ≈4.6); lid-clamp / IP67 / drop practice
results.detail: insert hole Ø4.00 mm, M3 L5.7 datasheet window Ø3.8–4.3

results.title: Lid screw clearance hole within ISO 273 window (M3: Ø3.2–3.7 mm)
results.source: ISO 273 clearance holes (M3 fine 3.2 / medium 3.4 / coarse 3.6); printed-hole shrink; IP67 lid-clamp practice
results.detail: screw clearance Ø3.40 mm for M3, ISO 273 window Ø3.2–3.7, counterbore Ø6.5

results.title: Battery rail slip fit 0.2–1.0 mm per side
results.source: 18650 holder moulding tolerance (±0.2 mm); SLA/PA12 printed-feature tolerance; 1.5 m drop practice
results.detail: rail gap 0.30 mm per side (slot 41.6 for 41.0 holder), window 0.2–1.0
